links.outcome: Correct, over-triage and under-triage rates of LLMs versus specialists on ESI vignettes
links.effect: GPT-4 correct triage 70.60 (±3.74); Gemini over-triage 35.2 (±2.93); specialists under-triage 32.90 (±11.83). In ESI 1-2, Gemini 87.77%, GPT-4 85.11%, specialists 49.33% correct.
links.quote: GPT-4 was found to have the highest correct triage rate with an average of 70.60 (±3.74), while Gemini had the highest over-triage rate with an average of 35.2 (±2.93) (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Triage accuracy of candidate LLMs compared with emergency medicine specialists on the same cases
links.effect: GPT-4 had the highest correct triage rate; in ESI 1-2, Gemini 87.77% and GPT-4 85.11% versus specialists 49.33% correct.
links.quote: In the ESI 1-2 class, Gemini had a correct triage rate of 87.77%, GPT-4 had 85.11%, and emergency medicine specialists had 49.33%.

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the accuracy of GPT-4 and Gemini compared to emergency medicine physicians on standardized vignettes from the ESI Implementation Handbook, without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
